name: mnemo-mcp
description: Persistent AI memory — store, search, and recall knowledge across sessions

MNEMO_URL.title: mnemo server URL (optional)
MNEMO_URL.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a running mnemo instance (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp). Start one with `uvx --from mnemo-mcp mnemo-mcp` or docker compose.

MNEMO_TOKEN.title: mnemo bearer token (optional)
MNEMO_TOKEN.description: Shared bearer token when the instance uses auth = "token" / "multi"; leave empty for a loopback no-auth instance.
